tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Amount quoted includes all the taxes applicable
The Bidder Should quote the Service Charges in percentage only. If Bidder quoted the Service Charges in another values, the tender will be liable for rejection
Rates are to be quoted in accordance with the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 as applicable in Karnataka, Labour Act, PF Act, ESI Act

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Attested copy of the latest three Years IT return filed by agency
Bidder should have annual turnover of Rs. 50 lakhs. Bidder should enclose turnover certificate and CA certificates
Bidder should submit EMD of Rs. 40,500/-
Bidder should submit LOC of Rs. 6.02 lakhs
They should be registered with appropriate authorities under Employees Provident Fund
They should be registered with appropriate authorities under Employees State Insurance Acts
They should have at least three years experience in providing manpower to Government Departments for an amount of Rs. 20.0 Lakhs
They should submit valid copy of Registration Certificate from Labour Dept
